compile.semantic_transition_policy: support/contact/guard custody changes only at authored decisive keys

keys.name: CROOKED_READY
keys.causal_role: establish offset ready with lead guard extended and rear hand chambered
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis slightly behind the lead guard; stance deliberately unequal

keys.name: GUARD_PRELOAD
keys.causal_role: compress under an incoming lateral line while rear hand begins crossing under the lead guard
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM sinks left of center before impact; guard endpoint is already established

keys.name: PRECONTACT_APERTURE
keys.causal_role: separate the threat arrival from contact; lead hand owns the aperture and rear hand is visibly approaching
keys.motion_arc_root_note: both feet still own support; pelvis drops one more cell before contact

keys.name: LEAD_GUARD_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: author contact at the already-placed lead hand and convert force into torso compression rather than endpoint reach
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact hand stays fixed while head/pelvis shear down-left

keys.name: CROSS_HAND_ACQUIRE
keys.causal_role: rear hand crosses into the load path before the lead hand is allowed to release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: both feet remain true support while the torso winds under a two-hand guard clamp

keys.name: GUARD_CUSTODY_HANDOFF
keys.causal_role: transfer threat-line custody to the crossing hand; lead arm peels only after the second guard owns contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: lead-side foot has degraded to toe-light but does not leave until handoff is complete

keys.name: CROSS_BODY_GUYWIRE
keys.causal_role: release the old lead foot only after guard custody is safe, creating a long cross-body tension line from contact hand to sole support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: single left-foot support; pelvis moves away from contact while free right leg folds high rather than pretending to plant

keys.name: CONTACT_RELEASE_FREE_LEG_SWEEP
keys.causal_role: let the threat clear without springback; released guard and free leg sweep on different lag clocks
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays left/low on sole support while free right foot travels through a high arc

keys.name: OUTSIDE_PREPLANT
keys.causal_role: author the exiting foot approach as explicitly unsupported before it becomes a new base
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot reaches outside the pelvis at floor-adjacent height but still cannot own the root

keys.name: EXIT_PLANT_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: allow the exiting foot to become support in compression; no height recovery yet
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new base is narrower and shifted left of origin; guard remains collapsed while legs absorb

keys.name: TORSION_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: spend stored cross-body torsion as an overtravel after support is already secure
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis overshoots right inside the new base while head/right guard lag farther right than final recovery

keys.name: COUNTER_TORQUE_GUARD_REOPEN
keys.causal_role: counter-rotate the trunk before the guard fully reopens; opposite hand and head settle on delayed arcs
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root returns left from overshoot but not to original address; right hand reopens late

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: finish action-capable but asymmetrically displaced; lead guard remains lower and stance remains compressed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: READY is re-entered five columns left of origin with residual guard-height and stance debt
